content.Title: 2021 ACC/AHA/SCAI Coronary Revascularization Guideline

Key Recommendations.Applicable Patients: Patients with left ventricular dysfunction and CAD
Key Recommendations.Comments: No significant survival benefit initially, but shows benefit over 10-year follow-up.

Key Recommendations.Recommendation: PCI or medical therapy for patients with left main CAD

Key Recommendations.Introduction: Based on recent evidence showing no advantage of CABG over medical therapy
Key Recommendations.Comments: Newer surgical techniques or drugs may have improved prognosis

Key Recommendations.Applicable Patients: Patients with multivessel CAD and stable ischemic heart disease

Clinical Trials and Studies: STICH (Surgical Treatment for Ischemic Heart Failure) Trial
Veterans Administration Coronary Artery Bypass Cooperative Study
content.Context: Evaluation of recent data to assess the need for revascularization procedures in specific patient populations
